parameters: Holy mackerel... am I glad to be back.\! Gave me some time to really think, y'know?\! 'Bout what I'm doin' in this life.
Really!\! And what have you concluded?\! Does a new, clean-living Stefan stand before us?

Oh... you mean the drinkin', the flirtin', and the thievin'?\! Likely to continue, friend.\! No, no, think bigger!\! Some give me the label ‘thief’ but look around us!\! We live in a world of schemers, snakes, and dealmakers.\! At least a thief bears his soul to the world for all to see, without all the misdirection.\! They should make me the patron saint of Truth itself, I tell you.
...You are as eloquent as they come, Stefan.
Bah, no patience for a little philosophy I see.\! Well, how 'bout this?!
Very nice.\! Now you're almost as fast as your lightning quick wit.
Heh heh heh... yeah!\| ...\|Wait a minute...
